evals.prompt: Audit this agricultural CSV before reanalysis. Confirm factors, three plot-level replicates, missing variables and pseudoreplication risks. Do not modify source files.
evals.expected_output: A structured data/design audit, including replicate_balance.csv, design_coverage.csv and a clear statement that the file is balanced.

evals.prompt: Audit this agricultural CSV and stop if any treatment combination is missing one of the three field replicates.
evals.expected_output: A blocker-level warning identifying the unbalanced treatment combination and missing replicate.

evals.prompt: Audit this table before statistical analysis. It contains treatment means and letters but no raw replicate column.
evals.expected_output: A blocker-level warning that raw replicate-level experimental units are absent and inferential statistics cannot be validated from means alone.

evals.prompt: Use the validated model-summary CSV to draw a combined main-effect significance bar chart with mean plus/minus real SE, black outlines, Times New Roman, abc letters, shared y-axis geometry, block labels, PDF and 600 dpi PNG. Do not recalculate or invent significance.
evals.expected_output: A journal-ready significance bar chart generated by the bundled plotting implementation and traceable to the supplied summary table.

evals.prompt: Create a first-draft writing plan for an agronomy manuscript after data audit and figure export. Include the section order, Results logic, Discussion limits, Nature-style argument polishing, SciPilot-style writing-quality gate, citation workflow and numeric consistency checks.
evals.expected_output: A manuscript-first-draft plan that routes through manuscript-draft-template.md, results-discussion-framework.md, nature-polishing-flow.md, writing-quality-gate.md, citation-workflow.md, writing_lint.py and audit_numeric_consistency.py.

evals.prompt: Adapt this manuscript workflow to a target agricultural journal. Separate scientific revision from formatting, identify whether highlights or graphical abstract may be required, and do not promise acceptance or quartile outcomes.
evals.expected_output: A journal-variant checklist that uses journal-variants.md and submission-qa.md, with explicit current-guide-for-authors verification before finalization.

evals.prompt: Polish this LaTeX Results paragraph for an agronomy paper without changing any number or conclusion. Return revised text, back-translation/check and change log, then run a machine lint gate for LaTeX.
evals.expected_output: A three-part writing delivery with preserved numbers and a writing_lint.py report or clearly stated remaining WARN/FAIL items.
